=SELECT
  (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'discovery')         AS cfg,
  (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'candidate_profile') AS profile,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
             'id', s.id, 'company_id', s.company_id, 'company_name', c.name, 'company_category', c.category,
             'ats', s.ats, 'board_token', s.board_token, 'endpoint_url', s.endpoint_url, 'search_text', s.search_text)
           ORDER BY s.id)
    FROM job_sources s JOIN companies c ON c.id = s.company_id
    WHERE s.is_active AND c.is_target), '[]'::json) AS sources;

=INSERT INTO jobs (source_id, company_id, external_id, fingerprint, title, location_raw, matched_location, is_remote,
                  department, employment_type, description_text, exp_min, exp_max, exp_text, exp_fit, exp_in_2_5,
                  salary_min_inr, salary_max_inr, salary_currency, salary_interval, salary_source, salary_text, comp_fit,
                  posted_at, job_url, apply_url, prefilter_pass, prefilter_reason, first_seen_run_id)
SELECT x.source_id, x.company_id, x.external_id, x.fingerprint, x.title, x.location_raw, x.matched_location, x.is_remote,
       x.department, x.employment_type, x.description_text, x.exp_min, x.exp_max, x.exp_text, x.exp_fit, x.exp_in_2_5,
       x.salary_min_inr, x.salary_max_inr, x.salary_currency, x.salary_interval, x.salary_source, x.salary_text, x.comp_fit,
       x.posted_at, x.job_url, x.apply_url, x.prefilter_pass, x.prefilter_reason, $2::int
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
       source_id int, company_id int, external_id text, fingerprint text, title text, location_raw text,
       matched_location text, is_remote boolean, department text, employment_type text, description_text text,
       exp_min smallint, exp_max smallint, exp_text text, exp_fit text, exp_in_2_5 boolean,
       salary_min_inr bigint, salary_max_inr bigint, salary_currency text, salary_interval text, salary_source text,
       salary_text text, comp_fit text, posted_at timestamptz, job_url text, apply_url text,
       prefilter_pass boolean, prefilter_reason text)
ON CONFLICT (source_id, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_seen_at     = now(),
  is_active        = true,
  expired_at       = NULL,
  apply_url        = EXCLUDED.apply_url,
  location_raw     = EXCLUDED.location_raw,
  matched_location = EXCLUDED.matched_location,
  prefilter_pass   = EXCLUDED.prefilter_pass,
  prefilter_reason = EXCLUDED.prefilter_reason,
  description_text = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.description_text, jobs.description_text);

UPDATE job_sources s SET
  last_status          = r.status,
  last_error           = r.error,
  verified             = s.verified OR r.ok,
  last_success_at      = CASE WHEN r.ok THEN now() ELSE s.last_success_at END,
  consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN r.ok THEN 0 ELSE s.consecutive_failures + 1 END,
  is_active            = CASE WHEN NOT r.ok AND s.consecutive_failures + 1 >= $4::int THEN false ELSE s.is_active END
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS r(source_id int, ok boolean, status int, error text)
WHERE s.id = r.source_id;

UPDATE jobs j SET is_active = false, expired_at = now()
FROM discovery_runs dr, jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS r(source_id int, ok boolean, complete boolean)
WHERE dr.id = $2::int AND r.ok AND j.source_id = r.source_id AND j.is_active
  AND j.last_seen_at < CASE WHEN r.complete THEN dr.started_at ELSE dr.started_at - interval '14 days' END;

UPDATE jobs j SET duplicate_of = d.id
FROM jobs d
WHERE j.first_seen_run_id = $2::int AND j.duplicate_of IS NULL
  AND d.fingerprint = j.fingerprint AND d.id < j.id AND d.duplicate_of IS NULL;

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen_run_id = $2::int)                               AS jobs_new,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen_run_id = $2::int AND duplicate_of IS NOT NULL)  AS jobs_duplicates
FROM jobs;

=SELECT j.id, j.title, j.location_raw, j.matched_location, j.is_remote, j.department, j.employment_type,
       j.description_text, j.exp_text, j.exp_fit, j.salary_source, j.salary_text, j.salary_currency,
       j.salary_min_inr, j.salary_max_inr, j.comp_fit, j.posted_at,
       c.name AS company, c.category AS company_category
FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id
WHERE j.is_active AND j.prefilter_pass AND j.duplicate_of IS NULL AND j.status = 'discovered'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_scores s WHERE s.job_id = j.id AND s.prompt_version = $1)
ORDER BY j.first_seen_at DESC, j.id DESC
LIMIT $2::int;

=INSERT INTO job_scores (job_id, prompt_version, model, total, technical, experience, location, company, compensation,
                        verdict, company_type, matched_skills, missing_skills, red_flags, summary, raw_response,
                        input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens)
SELECT x.job_id, x.prompt_version, x.model, x.total, x.technical, x.experience, x.location, x.company, x.compensation,
       x.verdict, x.company_type,
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.matched_skills)),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.missing_skills)),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.red_flags)),
       x.summary, x.raw_response, x.input_tokens, x.output_tokens, x.cache_read_tokens
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
       job_id bigint, prompt_version text, model text, total int, technical int, experience int, location int,
       company int, compensation int, verdict text, company_type text, matched_skills jsonb, missing_skills jsonb,
       red_flags jsonb, summary text, raw_response jsonb, input_tokens int, output_tokens int, cache_read_tokens int)
ON CONFLICT (job_id, prompt_version) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE jobs j SET
  salary_text    = u.salary_text,
  salary_source  = u.salary_source,
  salary_min_inr = COALESCE(u.salary_min_inr, j.salary_min_inr),
  salary_max_inr = COALESCE(u.salary_max_inr, j.salary_max_inr),
  comp_fit       = COALESCE(u.comp_fit, j.comp_fit)
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS u(job_id bigint, salary_text text, salary_source text,
                                        salary_min_inr bigint, salary_max_inr bigint, comp_fit text)
WHERE j.id = u.job_id AND j.salary_source = 'none';

INSERT INTO execution_log (workflow, execution_id, node, level, message, context)
SELECT 'A1 Job Discovery', $3, 'Claude: score job', 'warn', 'Scoring failed: ' || f.error, to_jsonb(f)
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($4::jsonb) AS f(job_id bigint, error text);

SELECT count(*) AS saved FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb);

=UPDATE discovery_runs dr SET
  finished_at       = now(),
  source_results    = $2::jsonb,
  sources_ok        = (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e WHERE (e->>'ok')::boolean),
  sources_failed    = (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e WHERE NOT (e->>'ok')::boolean),
  jobs_fetched      = (SELECT COALESCE(sum((e->>'fetched')::int), 0) FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e),
  jobs_prefiltered  = (SELECT COALESCE(sum((e->>'passed')::int), 0) FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e),
  jobs_new          = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE first_seen_run_id = dr.id),
  jobs_duplicates   = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE first_seen_run_id = dr.id AND duplicate_of IS NOT NULL),
  jobs_expired      = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE expired_at >= dr.started_at),
  jobs_scored       = (SELECT count(*) FROM job_scores WHERE created_at >= dr.started_at),
  jobs_score_failed = (SELECT count(*) FROM execution_log WHERE execution_id = $3 AND node = 'Claude: score job'),
  status = CASE
    WHEN jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb) > 0
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e WHERE (e->>'ok')::boolean) THEN 'failed'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) e WHERE NOT (e->>'ok')::boolean)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_log WHERE execution_id = $3 AND node = 'Claude: score job') THEN 'partial'
    ELSE 'succeeded' END
WHERE dr.id = $1::int;

INSERT INTO execution_log (workflow, execution_id, node, level, message, context)
SELECT 'A1 Job Discovery', $3, 'Finish run', CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 'info' ELSE 'warn' END,
       format('Discovery run %s %s: %s new, %s scored, %s expired, %s/%s sources failed',
              id, status, jobs_new, jobs_scored, jobs_expired, sources_failed, sources_ok + sources_failed),
       to_jsonb(dr) - 'source_results'
FROM discovery_runs dr WHERE id = $1::int;

SELECT dr.id AS run_id, dr.status, dr.jobs_fetched, dr.jobs_prefiltered, dr.jobs_new, dr.jobs_duplicates,
       dr.jobs_scored, dr.jobs_score_failed, dr.jobs_expired, dr.sources_ok, dr.sources_failed,
       COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
          SELECT m.company, m.title, m.matched_location, m.score, m.verdict, m.comp_fit, m.job_url
          FROM v_job_matches m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.id
          WHERE j.first_seen_run_id = dr.id AND m.score IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY m.score DESC LIMIT 5) t), '[]'::json) AS top_new_matches
FROM discovery_runs dr WHERE dr.id = $1::int;
